title: Achaemenes
summary: Raleigh names Achaemenes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Achaemenes, the sonne of Perses, of whose house Cyrus was, and from whom the Achaemenidae are named. Reineccius calls him the first King of Persia. The father named in that list is a gap and was not filled from Perses. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
